description: This file defines the PHP class `Filter` within the namespace `Opencart\Admin\Model\Catalog`. It implements various methods for managing filter groups and filters, including CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete) and retrieving filter data from the database, specifically for the admin section of an OpenCart catalog module.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Class for managing filters and filter groups within the OpenCart admin catalog module, supporting CRUD operations and data retrieval.

methods.name: addFilterGroup
methods.description: Creates a new filter group record in the database and adds descriptions for each language.

methods.name: editFilterGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing filter group record and its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteFilterGroup
methods.description: Deletes a filter group record and its descriptions based on its ID.

methods.name: getFilterGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a specific filter group record by ID, including its description.

methods.name: getFilterGroups
methods.description: Retrieves a list of filter groups, optionally filtered by name and paginated.

methods.name: getTotalFilterGroups
methods.description: Returns the total count of filter groups, with optional filtering by name.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a filter group in a specified language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific filter group.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all filter group descriptions in a particular language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a filter group, keyed by language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all filter group descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Creates a new filter record, including descriptions and associations.

methods.name: editFilter
methods.description: Updates an existing filter and its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteFilter
methods.description: Deletes a filter and its associated descriptions, also removing references in categories and products.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a filter, including its group and descriptions.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Retrieves a list of filters with optional filtering, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalFilters
methods.description: Returns the total number of filters, optionally filtered by name.

methods.name: getTotalFiltersByFilterGroupId
methods.description: Returns total filters belonging to a specific filter group.

methods.name: addFilterDescription
methods.description: Creates a description record for a filter in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteFilterDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific filter.

methods.name: deleteFilterDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all filter descriptions in a particular language.

methods.name: getFilterDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a filter, keyed by language ID.

methods.name: getFilterDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all filter descriptions for a specific language.
